overview_description.description: atira develops industry-specific AI agents for sales engineering and quoting in complex manufacturing. Its AI Sales Engineering Agent platform supports the sales engineering lifecycle by helping teams handle technical and commercial quoting activities. The company provides the software to manufacturing organizations that manage complex products and customer requirements.
